Package NetStrategies

package NetStrategies
Strategy interfaces and base classes used by the JSIM simulation engine to implement the behaviour of the network elements. Strategies are pluggable implementations of scheduling, routing, queueing, service and related policies, in line with the extended features of the JSIM engine described in the JMT user manual (finite capacity regions, fork-join, class switching, priorities and place-transition structures).
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    NetStrategies.CacheStrategies
    Cache eviction strategies used by cache-equipped stations to decide which cached item is removed when the cache is full.
    NetStrategies.ForkStrategies
    Strategies used by fork stations to split a job into the output tasks that are then routed to the downstream stations.
    NetStrategies.ImpatienceStrategies
    Impatience strategies that model customers leaving a queue before being served, either by balking (refusing to join the queue) or reneging (abandoning the queue after joining).
    NetStrategies.JoinStrategies
    Strategies used by join stations to synchronize the tasks of a forked job and release the job when its tasks have been recombined.
    NetStrategies.PSStrategies
    Processor sharing service strategies, in which every job present at the station is served simultaneously and the station capacity is shared among the jobs.
    NetStrategies.QueueGetStrategies
    Queue visit strategies that select which job leaves the queue to enter service, implementing scheduling disciplines such as FCFS, LCFS, SJF, LJF and SEPT.
    NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
    Queue insertion strategies that select the position in the queue where an arriving job is placed, implementing queueing disciplines such as FCFS and priority-based placement.
    NetStrategies.RoutingStrategies
    Routing strategies used by router nodes to select the destination station of each departing job.
    NetStrategies.SemaphoreStrategies
    Semaphore strategies controlling the release of permits in the place-transition (synchronization) structures of a JSIM model.
    NetStrategies.ServiceStrategies
    Service time strategies determining the service time of jobs at a station, including load independent and load dependent service distributions.
    NetStrategies.TransitionUtilities
    Utility classes for the transitions of the place-transition structures supported by the JSIM simulation engine.
    NetStrategies.VacationStrategies
    Vacation strategies modelling servers that suspend their service for a vacation period, as supported by the extended JSIM simulation engine.
